GenAI Orchestrator and Technical Lead for a child support modernization project — the first to leverage ADLC for development. Designed agentic workflows that: (a) identify change logs, (b) conduct impact analysis (including a GenAI agent that assesses holistic system impacts from even vague requirements), (c) generate implementation plans, (d) develop code, (e) review outcomes with independent models, and (f) run and fix Security/ADA scans.  These innovations increased efficiency by ~35% and moved project go-live up by four months, a significant achievement.
Post-development, a defect triage agent analyzes code and documentation to distinguish true/false defects, offering fixes when needed—reducing batch defect resolution time by ~50%.
Leading a 14-member team — including SC, Consultants, and Analysts — to complete DDI, along with optimizing build configuration, reducing build time by ~20%.

Built a high-performing delivery team establishing clear roles, effective ways of working, and robust engineering standards.
Personally onboarded over 30 practitioners by developing targeted documentation and concise training videos, resulting in a 30–40% reduction in ramp-up time.
Instituted agile ceremonies and team norms that foster inclusion, shared ownership, and continuous learning. Regularly facilitated code reviews and collaborative working sessions to accelerate issue resolution and knowledge transfer.
These initiatives have significantly improved team motivation and created a collaborative culture, consistently earning positive feedback and strong support from both team members and stakeholders.

Future of Services
Developed an agentic Impact Analysis tool capable of processing high-level or incomplete requirements, refining them, and analyzing their end-to-end impact on existing systems. By identifying potential implications early in the lifecycle, this tool significantly reduces rework and enables proactive planning.
This solution is currently leveraged across GPS for both onshore and offshore teams.

GPS Industry Proficiency – Child Support
Collaborating with Learning & Development to design tailored trainings on child support systems for the GPS practice, ensuring our teams are equipped with specialized knowledge to better serve client needs.

Quantified delivery impacts include 
a) ~80% documentation effort reduction
b) ~30% increase in sprint deliverables
c) ~20% build time reduction
